---
title: "COVID-19 Cases in Mexico"
author: "Kristina Baus, Sheena Lim, Lauren McGarvey, Elenzie France, and Abigail Yemisrach"
date: "2026-11-12"
output: html_document
params:
  outcome: "all"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
```

```{r, here-i-am, include = FALSE}
here::i_am("report.Rmd")
```

```{r load-data}
covid_data <- read_csv(
  here("data", "covid_sub.csv")
)
```

```{r coder1-heading, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (params$outcome %in% c("all", "pneumonia")) {
  cat("## Coder 1: Pneumonia and Sex\n\n")
  cat("This analysis examines whether pneumonia prevalence differs between male and female patients.\n\n")
  cat("### Table 1: Pneumonia by Sex\n\n")
}
```

```{r coder1-table, eval=params$outcome %in% c("all", "pneumonia")}
table1 <- readRDS(
  here::here("outputs/coder1/table1.rds")
)

table1
```

```{r coder1-figure-heading, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (params$outcome %in% c("all", "pneumonia")) {
  cat("### Figure 1: Pneumonia by Sex\n\n")
}
```

```{r coder1-figure, eval=params$outcome %in% c("all", "pneumonia"), out.width="85%"}
knitr::include_graphics(
  here::here("outputs/coder1/figure1.png")
)
```


```{r coder2-table, eval=params$outcome %in% c("all", "classification")}

)
```


```{r coder4-heading, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (params$outcome %in% c("all", "hospitalization")) {
  cat("## Coder 4: Hospitalization and Sex\n\n")
  cat("### Table 4: Hospitalization by Sex\n\n")
}
```

```{r coder4-table, eval=params$outcome %in% c("all", "hospitalization")}
table4 <- readRDS(
  here::here("outputs/coder4/table4.rds")
)
knitr::kable(
  table4$table,
  caption = "Hospitalization Status by Sex",
  align = "lcc"
)

cat(
  "\n\n**Chi-square test p-value:**",
  format.pval(table4$chi_square$p.value, digits = 3),
  "\n\n"
)

```
